name: RustDeskServer-AiO
description: Self-host your own RustDesk Server, it is free and open source. This container includes both the RustDesk Server and the RustDesk Relay in one and starts it.

ports.name: TCP - RustDesk Server/Relay
ports.description: Necessary default ports for the server: TCP: 21115, 21116, 21118 UDP: 21116 Necessary default ports for the relay: TCP: 21117, 21119

variables.name: Enable RustDesk Server
variables.description: The server needs by default the following ports to work properly: TCP: 21115, 21116, 21118 UDP: 21116

variables.name: Rust Desk Server Parameters
variables.description: Enter your extra start up parameters for the server here if necessary.

variables.name: Enabel RustDesk Relay
variables.description: The relay needs by default the following ports to work properly: TCP: 21117, 21119

variables.name: Rust Desk Relay Parameters
variables.description: Enter your extra start up parameters for the relay here if necessary.
